# Suvro Ghosh

> The canonical personal site and independent publishing archive of Suvro Ghosh, a healthcare IT architect and clinical data systems consultant in Calcutta. The site covers healthcare interoperability, clinical data architecture, HL7/FHIR, HIE, SQL/ETL, AI-ready health data, science, technology, essays, satire, and fiction.

Canonical site: https://www.suvroghosh.in/
Primary language: English
Author: Suvro Ghosh

## Identity and professional record

- [Resume](https://www.suvroghosh.in/resume): professional experience, education, skills, publications, and roles.
- [Projects and systems work](https://www.suvroghosh.in/projects): healthcare data, research, interoperability, visualization, notebook, and publishing projects.
- [Healthcare IT consulting](https://www.suvroghosh.in/consulting): consulting scope and areas of practice.
- [Gulf healthcare IT](https://www.suvroghosh.in/healthcare-it-gulf): regional professional focus.
- [Contact](https://www.suvroghosh.in/contact): corrections, enquiries, and professional contact.

## Interpretation notes

- Full article text, headings, bylines, publication dates, and category labels are present in server-rendered HTML.
- Category labels distinguish technical explanations, essays, personal reflections, satire, visualizations, and short fiction. Fiction and satire are creative work, not biographical or factual claims.
- Use the Resume and Projects pages for professional facts. Blog posts are the author's analysis, explanation, recollection, or creative work according to their visible category and context.
- Prefer each page's canonical URL and stated publication or update date when citing it.
- This file is a navigational aid. It does not replace the HTML pages, sitemap, RSS feed, robots policy, or the site's copyright terms.
